description: Work out the whole shopping list for one room from the person's answers. Arguments are the same named parameters as /plan.json. A job is required. Repeated door, window and opening values are arrays. No price is used; price arguments are ignored and named in the answer.

bath.description: A bath or shower tray: a name (bath-1700, tray-900) or its length along the wall x its rim height x how far it comes into the room, in the units. The wall behind it comes off up to the rim, and its footprint off a floor being laid. The key may be repeated.

items.description: A bath or shower tray: a name (bath-1700, tray-900) or its length along the wall x its rim height x how far it comes into the room, in the units. The wall behind it comes off up to the rim, and its footprint off a floor being laid. The key may be repeated.

board.description: Whether the plasterboard uses labelled example figures (quick) or figures from the board and system specification (custom). Needed for the keys below to take effect.

board.adhesive.description: Wall boards one bag of plasterboard adhesive fixes, from its instructions.

board.finish.description: How the boards will be finished.

board.fixing.description: How the boards will be fixed.

board.layers.description: Whole layers from the complete system specification.

board.skim.description: Metres squared one bag of finish plaster covers, from the bag.

carpet.description: Whether the carpet uses the labelled example roll figures (quick) or figures from the carpet and shop (custom). Needed for the keys below to take effect.

carpet.allowance.description: The trimming allowance in metres, added once to each room measurement.

carpet.covering.description: What is laid from the roll: carpet (with underlay and gripper) or sheet vinyl (loose laid, taped or glued; no underlay). Sheet vinyl is sold in 2, 3 and 4 m widths; its quick example is a 3 m roll.

carpet.direction.description: Which way the pile or pattern must run. Not decided lets the planner show the smaller one-piece cut that fits.

carpet.step.description: The step in metres in which the shop sells the cut length.

carpet.underlay.description: Metres squared covered by one chosen underlay roll or pack.

carpet.width.description: The fixed width of the carpet roll in metres.

ceiling.description: What the ceiling gets: paint, board or none.

ceilingpaint.description: Whether the ceiling paint uses the labelled example figures (quick) or figures read off the tin (custom). Needed for the keys below to take effect.

ceilingpaint.coats.description: Coats on the tin, for the ceiling paint. Custom only.

ceilingpaint.coverage.description: Metres squared covered by one litre in one coat, from the tin, for the ceiling paint. Custom only.

ceilingpaint.examples.description: Which of coats, coverage, extra and tins are still the labelled example figures. Leave it out unless the planner wrote it.

ceilingpaint.extra.description: Percent to add for waste and touch-ups, for the ceiling paint. Custom only.

ceilingpaint.tins.description: Tin sizes in litres, comma separated, for the ceiling paint. A size may carry a price after "@": the price is accepted and ignored.

check.description: Line ids, comma separated, to mark Check first before the list is made. The ids are in the answer's lines. Rarely needed.

concrete.description: Whether the concrete slab uses labelled example figures (quick) or the thickness decided for the job and figures read off the bag (custom). Needed for the keys below to take effect. The room is the slab: its length and width, no height.

concrete.extra.description: Percent to add for an uneven base and spillage.

concrete.step.description: The step in cubic metres the supplier sells ready-mixed concrete in. Ready-mixed only; optional.

concrete.supply.description: Bags of dry mix, or ready-mixed concrete delivered by the cubic metre.

concrete.thickness.description: Slab thickness in millimetres, decided for the job. BuildBatch suggests none.

concrete.weight.description: The weight of one bag in kilograms. Bags only.

concrete.yield.description: Cubic metres one bag makes, as printed on the bag. Bags only.

door.description: One per door, the key repeated for more. A typical size by name (the names are in /ask.json) or width x height in the units. Add *2 for two the same.

items.description: One per door, the key repeated for more. A typical size by name (the names are in /ask.json) or width x height in the units. Add *2 for two the same.

end.description: Written by the planner as the last pair of a list link: the number of pairs before it. Leave it out of a call.

fitting.description: How the floor is fitted. Default unsure. Used by flooring jobs.

floor.description: Whether the flooring uses the labelled example figures (quick) or figures read off the pack (custom). Needed for the keys below to take effect.

floor.adhesive.description: Floor tiles: metres squared one bag of adhesive covers.

floor.covering.description: What the floor is. Default laminate.

floor.examples.description: Which of extra and packs are still the labelled example figures. Leave it out unless the planner wrote it.

floor.extra.description: Percent to add for cuts. Custom only.

floor.grout.description: Floor tiles: metres squared one bag of grout covers.

floor.packs.description: Metres squared in one pack or box, comma separated for several sizes. A size may carry a price after "@": the price is accepted and ignored.

floor.tileh.description: Floor tiles: the other side of a tile, in millimetres (with floor.tilew).

floor.tilew.description: Floor tiles: one side of a tile, in millimetres, for a count of tiles (with floor.tileh). Optional; the boxes are still counted by area.

floor.underlay.price.description: Accepted and ignored: this interface uses no prices.

floor.underlay.roll.description: Metres squared in one roll of underlay.

ground.description: Whether the floor is on the ground floor. Default unsure. Used by flooring jobs.

have.description: Line ids, comma separated, to mark Already have before the list is made. The ids are in the answer's lines. Rarely needed.

height.description: Floor to ceiling, in the units. Needed when walls are painted, papered, tiled or boarded (paint-carpet too); not for flooring, carpet, loft insulation, concrete or skirting alone.

job.description: The job. Required. wallpaper is the paint job with papered walls and no ceiling; tiles is the paint job with tiled walls and no ceiling; both is paint and a new floor; paint-carpet is paint and one unjoined piece of carpet; skirting is skirting and architrave.

length.description: One side of the floor, in the units. A length may carry its own unit (360cm, 4200mm). Not needed when plan is given.

lengths.description: Whether the skirting and architrave lengths are the labelled examples (quick) or the lengths the shop sells (custom). Needed for the keys below to take effect.

lengths.architrave.description: Length the architrave is sold in, in metres.

lengths.architrave.price.description: Accepted and ignored: this interface uses no prices.

lengths.skirting.description: Length the skirting is sold in, in metres.

lengths.skirting.price.description: Accepted and ignored: this interface uses no prices.

loft.description: Whether the loft insulation uses labelled example figures (quick) or figures measured in the loft and read from the chosen roll (custom). Needed for the keys below to take effect.

loft.depth.description: Thickness of one new mineral-wool layer in millimetres, from the chosen roll.

loft.extra.description: Percent to add for cuts and fitting.

loft.pack.description: Square metres covered by one chosen roll or pack.

loft.target.description: Chosen target insulation depth in millimetres.

name.description: What the room is called. Do not send one: it is carried into the links the answer gives, and the person can add it there.

need.description: Line ids, comma separated, to mark Need before the list is made. The ids are in the answer's lines. Rarely needed.

not-needed.description: Line ids, comma separated, to mark Not needed before the list is made. The ids are in the answer's lines. Rarely needed.

opening.description: Any other opening to take off the walls (a garage door, an archway), as width x height or a name. The key may be repeated.

items.description: Any other opening to take off the walls (a garage door, an archway), as width x height or a name. The key may be repeated.

paper.description: Whether the wallpaper is the labelled example roll (quick) or read off the label (custom). Needed for the keys below to take effect.

paper.paste.description: Rolls one packet of paste does.

paper.price.description: Accepted and ignored: this interface uses no prices.

paper.repeat.description: Pattern repeat in centimetres. 0 or left out for none.

plan.description: A room that is not a rectangle: its corners in turn, in metres whatever units says, as x,y pairs separated by ";". Replaces length and width. Up to 24 corners.

subfloor.description: What is under a new floor. Default unsure. Used by flooring jobs.

surface.description: What the painted surfaces are like now. Default sound, the planner's own default. Used by painting jobs.

trim.description: New skirting, architrave or both, with any job. Default skirting for the skirting job, else none.

units.description: What length, width, height and the doors are measured in. Default m. In ft write 13ft9in, or 13 for whole feet.

v.description: The version of the format. 1. Left out, 1 is assumed and the answer says so.

wallpaint.description: Whether the wall paint uses the labelled example figures (quick) or figures read off the tin (custom). Needed for the keys below to take effect.

wallpaint.coats.description: Coats on the tin, for the wall paint. Custom only.

wallpaint.coverage.description: Metres squared covered by one litre in one coat, from the tin, for the wall paint. Custom only.

wallpaint.examples.description: Which of coats, coverage, extra and tins are still the labelled example figures. Leave it out unless the planner wrote it.

wallpaint.extra.description: Percent to add for waste and touch-ups, for the wall paint. Custom only.

wallpaint.tins.description: Tin sizes in litres, comma separated, for the wall paint. A size may carry a price after "@": the price is accepted and ignored.

walls.description: What the walls get. The job sets it, so it is rarely needed: paint, wallpaper, tiles, board or none.

walltiles.description: Whether the wall tiles are the labelled example box (quick) or read off the box (custom). Needed for the keys below to take effect.

walltiles.adhesive.description: Metres squared one bag of adhesive covers.

walltiles.box.description: Metres squared in one box. Custom only.

walltiles.grout.description: Metres squared one bag of grout covers.

walltiles.height.description: Metres up the wall the tiles go. Left out: to the ceiling.

walltiles.price.description: Accepted and ignored: this interface uses no prices.

walltiles.tileh.description: The other side of a wall tile, in millimetres (with walltiles.tilew).

walltiles.tilew.description: One side of a wall tile, in millimetres, for a count of tiles (with walltiles.tileh). Optional; the boxes are still counted by area.

width.description: The other side of the floor, in the units. Not needed when plan is given.

window.description: One per window, the key repeated for more. A typical size by name or width x height in the units. Add *2 for two the same.

items.description: One per window, the key repeated for more. A typical size by name or width x height in the units. Add *2 for two the same.

name: plan_room
title: Plan one room with BuildBatch
